name: Brevard Zen Center / Ryugen-ji
reason: too thin. brevardzen.org (read 13 Nov 2026) lists one current programme (Saturday morning zazen in Cocoa, FL); its only sesshin (9-13 Sep 2026) is past and its zazenkai have dates TBD (last announced for June 2023); the rest is a reading list and a teachers page about Maezumi Roshi. The only photo (two priests on a porch) is from its former West Melbourne site, and pages still mix old and new addresses.
